messages:
cara_devrel: Heads-up from a user onboarding call — they hit the app-starter quickstart and their first POST to /v1/generate opened the billing setup page in-browser instead of surfacing a JSON error. They had trial credits.

leo: ugh. Which runtime? local dev server or the hosted example?

cara_devrel: local node starter, default proxy route `/api/proxy/generate` that forwards to Redwood API. They set REDWOOD_API_KEY to an org key from their invite.

junior_dev: repro steps they gave: clone repo, `npm install`, `REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_... npm run dev`, open http://localhost:3000, press "Generate", page navigates to /console/billing/setup.

billing-bot: observed: backend returned 402 payload `{ "error": "billing_required", "reason": "no_payment_method" }` at 2026-03-24T08:12:09Z. Proxy then got a 302 from /console/billing/setup for that UA.

leo: so API did the right thing (402 JSON) but the proxy/fetch followed the redirect to console HTML. The SDK should surface JSON or throw an error, not follow.

prio_ops: we recently deployed a change: any workspace created via invite without explicit trial flag gets gated until billing configured. That may be the real cause for the billing_required. But UX should be clearer.

cara_devrel: main asks: 1) update sample app so client sees billing JSON and shows CTA (not redirect), 2) decide if invite-created workspaces should get trial credits automatically, 3) ensure SDK/agent libraries don't auto-follow console redirects.

junior_dev: quick win: in the browser fetch, set `redirect: 'manual'` and check `response.status` / `response.headers.get('location')` then show a friendly banner linking to billing. Also add a clear error message for 402 responses.

leo: agree. Also check node proxy code: if it's using `node-fetch` or `axios`, they follow redirects by default. We should change the proxy to forward the 402 body and not follow 3xx when proxied to browser endpoints.

billing-bot: note: workspace wks_09G82XYZ created via invite by user id usr_77 had metadata `trial_provisioned: false`. Last billing check showed credits=0.

prio_ops: I'm going to open an ops ticket to audit invite flow and add a migration to set trial_provisioned=true for recent invites (with safety checks).

leo: I'll submit a PR to the starter repo: change fetch to `redirect: 'manual'`, add UI flow for 402 with CTA+help link, update README with expected billing gating behavior. @cara_devrel can you pair-review?

cara_devrel: yes, will review. Also let's add a unit test simulating proxy returning 402 + location header and assert UI doesn't navigate.

sdk-bot: suggestion: add an SDK-level contract test to ensure server APIs return JSON error bodies for programmatic clients; fail builds if HTML redirects are emitted for API endpoints.

junior_dev: I'll add the unit test and a small e2e that mocks a workspace without billing to show the new banner.

prio_ops: filing INC-2026-085: invite-workspace-trial-mismatch. Adding logs from billing-bot and the user's repro steps.

cara_devrel: thanks team. I'll message the user with a temporary workaround: set up org billing or ask inviter to provision trial, and we'll follow up when PRs land. :thumbsup:
